_: D292 (research/99): the language of a message, of a conversation, and of the words an app shows. detect: the language a message is in (null = none of its own; sure = the language and not only its script). conversation: messages oldest first and the language after each. inLanguage: may this text be shown as is to a reader of that language. normalize, chain, negotiate: tags and the interface's fallback. The TypeScript (packages/protocol/src/lang.ts) and Go (apps/desktop/internal/lang) versions both pass these cases.
